T2_hero.h1: EVOLIS System — automated processor for EIA
T2_hero.lead: An open Bio-Rad microplate system that automates enzyme immunoassay processing stages.

T3_about.h2: What EVOLIS System is and who it is for
T3_about.text: EVOLIS System is an automated open Bio-Rad microplate processor for EIA methods. Designed for laboratories running 30,000–100,000 tests annually, it automates dispensing, washing, incubation, and reading. Its open architecture allows EIA protocols to be configured, while capacity for up to 180 primary tubes and 4–7 plates supports batch-based sample processing within a worklist.

items.text: EVOLIS System handles dispensing, washing, incubation, and reading of microtiter plates. This brings consecutive EIA stages together in one automated system.

The open architecture supports protocol configuration for EIA assays. Four temperature-controlled incubators and four light-protected ambient incubators provide the conditions specified by each protocol.

According to the manufacturer, the system supports continuous loading and bidirectional LIS connectivity. Disposable tips, positive identification, and triple detection help control material handling.

items.q: What workload is EVOLIS System designed for?
items.a: The system is designed for 30,000–100,000 tests per year.

items.q: Which EIA stages does EVOLIS System automate?

items.q: How many samples and plates can EVOLIS System handle?

items.q: Who supplies and maintains EVOLIS System in Ukraine?
